superPowers.name: Rough Around the Edges
superPowers.body: When this character would be removed from the battlefield, enemy characters within |!range| 2 of this character suffer 1 |!damage|. An allied |*Ultron, Metal Tyrant| gains 1 |!power| for each |!damage| dealt this way. Then this character is removed from the battlefield.

superPowers.name: Programmed for Destruction
superPowers.body: This character cannot pick up, hold, Interact with, or Contest objective tokens.

superPowers.name: Flight, Grunts [Ultron, Metal Tyrant], Immunity [Bleed, Poison]
